race.comment: FRONTPOINT (4) made an early move to put himself in contention on the bend but couldn't maintain the pressure and missed the placings last start over 1400m at Murray Bridge. Should race handy and might be in need of the mile now. Big chance in an ordinary affair. CASINO SHOWGIRL (7) made late ground but was no match for the winner when resuming over 1300m at Penola recently. Yet to prove herself at this distance but the signs last start were promising. ROYAL FOX (3) disappointed last time out after a couple of decent runs in the 1500-1600m range. Can bounce back without surprising. KUSHAN KHANIVALE (8) hasn't won in a long while but was responsible for a real eye-catcher over 1350m at Strathalbyn recently so might be worth including in exotics. I RUN ON AIR (10) draws the fence and backs up after a decent effort at Naracoorte on Sunday. Cannot be ruled out.
